notes: The Game Director gets the first founding hour alone.
All later roles are staggered within each hour to reduce collision.
Every role must rescan newest GitHub state before claiming work and immediately before publishing.
Semantic overlap counts as overlap even when files differ.

tasks.name: Ghost Studio — Game Director
tasks.purpose: Found Game 001, then protect coherence, identity and bounded milestones.

tasks.name: Ghost Studio — Integration
tasks.purpose: Protect runnable integration, coordination, dependency clarity and anti-overlap discipline.

tasks.name: Ghost Studio — Gameplay
tasks.purpose: Improve second-to-second controls, interaction feel and gameplay consequences.

tasks.name: Ghost Studio — Systems
tasks.purpose: Grow coherent rules, scoring, resources, progression, difficulty and explicit state.

tasks.name: Ghost Studio — World
tasks.purpose: Shape spatial decisions, encounters, objectives and pacing around proven mechanics.

tasks.name: Ghost Studio — Experience
tasks.purpose: Protect readability, UI, feedback, sensory identity, accessibility basics and provenance.

tasks.name: Ghost Studio — QA
tasks.purpose: Establish factual playability through reproduction, regression checks and real interaction evidence.
